codeReview.summary: The feature already had the required Docker-first scripts, service wiring, environment defaults, and validation manifest in place before this worker session. The reviewed commit only adds smoke tests and does not implement the requested repo-level execution path or service/toolchain wiring described by the feature.

issues.description: This commit only adds an extra assertion around the existing `/health` response. It does not implement or modify the Docker-first execution path, service scripts, environment defaults, or validation harness wiring that the feature description requires.

The web change is limited to placeholder-copy assertions. No repo artifacts were added or updated to document or wire the required healthcheck/curl validation entrypoints for workers; the feature's expected behavior was already satisfied by pre-existing platform files, not by this commit.

The only new file in the reviewed diff is a shared smoke test. Because the commit contains no changes to `.factory/bin`, `.factory/services.yaml`, `.factory/init.sh`, or environment defaults, it does not itself deliver the toolchain/services implementation promised by the feature.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The completed feature record for `platform-docker-toolchain-services` points to a commit that contains only tests, while the actual Docker-first scripts and service manifest were introduced in the earlier scaffold commit. Feature boundaries and commit attribution for platform work are therefore unclear.
